# Capability catalog

Capabilities constrain **plugin processes**, not end-user RBAC. Declare `capabilities` in the manifest; the host may imply a minimal set from backend/settings/jobs/`mail.provider`. First enable requires operator confirmation.

Source of truth: Go catalogs under `apps/api` (`app/Support/Events`, `Capabilities`, `ExtensionManifest`, `Jobs`, and provider slot constants). Regenerate with:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate
```

Or verify CI drift:

```bash
cd apps/api && go run ./cmd/sforum extension docs generate --check
```

| Key | Risk | Label (EN) | Label (ZH) | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host.api` | low | Call Host API | 调用宿主 API | Use the versioned host surface (sforum.host/v1) for permission checks, settings, jobs, and audit. |
| `settings.own` | low | Own extension settings | 读写自身设置 | Read and write settings belonging only to this extension. |
| `permissions.check` | low | Check user permissions | 校验用户权限 | Ask the host whether an actor holds a permission key; cannot grant permissions. |
| `jobs.enqueue` | medium | Enqueue background jobs | 入队后台任务 | Enqueue River jobs for job kinds declared in the plugin manifest only. |
| `audit.append` | medium | Append audit events | 追加审计记录 | Append structured audit events under this extension's namespace. |
| `net.outbound` | high | Outbound network | 出站网络 | Open outbound network connections (HTTP, SMTP, etc.) from the plugin process or via Host helpers. |
| `users.read` | high | Read user profiles | 读取用户信息 | Read safe, non-secret user fields through the Host API. |
| `users.email.read` | high | Read own email address | 读取本人邮箱地址 | Read the signed-in actor's own primary email address through the capability- and delegation-gated consent query. Never grants access to other users, never enters stable views, and every read is audited. |
| `extensions.read` | medium | Read extension inventory | 读取扩展清单 | Read a redacted extension inventory and public runtime/contract state. Never exposes secrets, trust tokens, package paths, or credentials. |
| `extensions.call` | medium | Call extension services | 调用扩展服务 | Invoke declared plugin services or providers through Host Service Discovery with live exact-artifact admission. |
| `extensions.manage` | high | Manage trusted extensions | 管理受信任扩展 | Perform allowlisted settings update/reset/action and disable of already-trusted non-system non-self plugins via Host Commands. Never replaces super_admin trust confirmation. |
| `ai.invoke` | medium | Invoke Host AI gateway | 调用宿主 AI 网关 | Send AI completion requests through the Host gateway so cost accounting, rate limits, and audit stay host-owned. Subject and cost gates still apply per request. |
| `events.emit` | low | Emit own-namespace events | 发布自身命名空间事件 | Publish events strictly under this extension's namespace through the Host event channel; core event names and other plugins' namespaces stay closed. |
| `badges.fact.write` | medium | Write plugin fact counters | 写入插件事实计数 | Report per-user badge fact counters only through the Host badges.fact.record command. The Host clamps deltas, enforces bounds, and audits every write; it never grants direct access to badge or counter tables. |

### Risk tiers

- **low** — routine host calls (Host API surface, own settings, permission checks)
- **medium** — side effects operators should review (enqueue jobs, append audit)
- **high** — sensitive data or network (user reads, outbound network)
